title: rosa gymnocarpa var. willmottiae
intro: Rosa gymnocarpa var. willmottiae, commonly known as Western wild rose, is a plant species native to western North America, known for its fragrant flowers and edible hips. The health benefits of Western wild rose include its ability to treat digestive issues and menstrual cramps due to its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of the plant include acting as an antispasmodic and an anti-inflammatory, making it useful for relieving pain and reducing swelling. Bioactive constituents of Western wild rose include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and fragrances, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
